title: Fuel Composition Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
shortDescription: PCM detected: fuel composition sensor circuit range/performance.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates fuel composition sensor circuit range/performance. The PCM monitors related signals against learned thresholds and stores the code when the fault matures.

Ignoring it can lead to driveability issues, increased emissions, or progressive component damage.
safetyImpact: Fuel mixture may be incorrect; monitor for stalling.

fixSteps.title: Scan and capture freeze frame
fixSteps.instruction: Read all stored and pending codes; record freeze-frame data.

fixSteps.title: Visual inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect fuel composition sensor wiring, connectors and related components for damage.

fixSteps.title: Electrical test
fixSteps.instruction: Verify reference, ground, and signal at the affected connector with engine running.

fixSteps.title: Replace component
fixSteps.instruction: If circuit checks pass, replace the suspect fuel composition sensor and clear codes.

faq.a: Yes if engine runs normally; otherwise flatbed.
No - sensor replacement is typically required.

fixSteps.instruction: Verify reference, ground, and signal at the affected connector with engine running.

fixSteps.title: Replace component
fixSteps.instruction: If circuit checks pass, replace the suspect O2 sensor and clear codes.
